summary: Checkout requests timed out after the database connection pool saturated.
error_logs: checkout-api ERROR db.pool: checkout timed out after 5.0s (pool_size=30, checked_out=30, overflow=0)
checkout-api WARN http.server: route=/v1/checkout status=503 p95_ms=6200
root_cause: A connection leak on an exception path left connections checked out after failed inventory lookups.
resolution_steps: Restarted affected checkout workers to release stranded connections and restore service.
Fixed connection cleanup with a context manager around the inventory lookup transaction.
Added an alert for pool saturation and a regression test for the exception path.
